review.title: Application security review
scope: Describe included components, repositories, and environments
methodology: Describe evidence sources and checks actually performed
review.summary: Summarize scope, outcome, and material limitations without claiming certification.

findings.title: Replace this sample with a real, evidenced finding
findings.evidence: Redacted evidence only; never paste secret values or unnecessary personal data.
findings.description: Describe the verified behavior or explicitly state why this remains a potential risk.
findings.scenario: Describe realistic prerequisites and the security boundary affected.
findings.likelihood: Explain exposure and prerequisites; do not invent a numeric probability.
findings.mitigation: Describe the control that would reduce or remove the risk.
